seo.h1: What Is Bonefish Grill's Bang Bang Shrimp?

question: What Is Bonefish Grill's Bang Bang Shrimp?
quick_answer: Bang Bang Shrimp is Bonefish Grill's most famous appetizer: crispy, lightly battered shrimp tossed in a creamy, spicy signature sauce and served over greens. It is a cult favorite, usually priced around $12 to $13, and it often shows up on happy-hour and promotional deals.
key_facts: Crispy shrimp in a creamy, spicy sauce
Frequently featured in happy-hour and promo deals

body.heading: What it is
body.text: Bang Bang Shrimp is a plate of small, crispy shrimp that are lightly battered, fried, and then tossed in a creamy, spicy sauce. The result is crunchy on the outside with a rich, slightly sweet-and-spicy coating, usually served over a bed of greens as a starter.

body.heading: Why it is so popular
body.text: It has become Bonefish Grill's calling card. Many people visit specifically for the Bang Bang Shrimp, and the chain leans into that by featuring it in happy-hour menus and limited-time promotions. The flavor and the low-ish starter price make it easy to order on almost every visit.

body.heading: What it costs
body.text: Prices vary by location, but Bang Bang Shrimp is typically around $12 to $13 as a regular appetizer, and sometimes less during happy hour or special offers. Check the Bonefish Grill menu page for the current pricing and portion options at your local restaurant.

faqs.q: How much is Bang Bang Shrimp at Bonefish Grill?
faqs.a: It is usually around $12 to $13 as a starter, though it can be cheaper during happy hour or promotions. Prices vary by location.
